FIRMWARE_VERIFIED: Firmware verified. Restarting with the new image.
FIRMWARE_REJECTED: Firmware verification failed. The active image is preserved.
INVALID_CONFIG: Check the fields. Use a lowercase Homie ID and an admin password of at least 12 characters.
CONFIG_SAVED: Configuration saved. Restarting; reconnect to your Wi-Fi and open the chime IP address.
PLAY_UNAVAILABLE: The chime is not available for playback.
INVALID_BOOLEAN: Send true or false as plain text.
INVALID_CA: Select a CA certificate in DER format.
AUTH_FAILED: Incorrect password. During initial setup, use the access point password.
OPERATION_BUSY: Wait for the current operation to finish.
OTA_NOT_READY: OTA is not ready or the image size is invalid.
UPLOAD_REJECTED: Upload rejected; the active image is preserved.
SOUND_SAVED: Sound uploaded and verified. It is ready to play.
SOUND_REJECTED: Sound upload failed verification. The previously selected sound has not been overwritten.
SOUND_SIZE: Select a WAV file between 46 bytes and 512 KiB.
SOUND_UNAVAILABLE: Sound upload is unavailable. Wait for boot confirmation and idle playback.
